objective: Select only current marketplace work that can beat the existing employment/event path after client trust, binding compensation, smartphone feasibility, workload, payment, privacy, and elapsed-time gates.

reasons: Compensation and scope are deferred to an interview instead of binding the advertised range.
No deliverable, quantity, hours, or due date is stated.
The client has no reviews and has not completed identity or ordering-rule checks.
Ongoing image, video, analytics, posting, and account-management work is not evidenced as smartphone-completable.
The current paid deliverable is only a 30-60 minute screening interview for JPY 500; the JPY 30,000-50,000 work is not guaranteed.
The application requires prior account, view, and follower-growth metrics plus on-site availability.
It cannot close the JPY 20,800 gap as a binding current contract.
The trusted client and smartphone allowance pass, but unit economics fail.
The initial rate is JPY 10 per image and continuation rate JPY 5 before platform fees.
Closing the current JPY 20,800 gap would require 2,080 initial-rate images or 4,160 continuation-rate images, plus file and spreadsheet operations.

selection.reason: All three candidates fail at least one binding-value or feasibility gate. The verified employment plus safe event-shift path remains faster per elapsed time and user operation.

success_condition_for_future_marketplace: Verified client or warm contact; fixed paid deliverable and quantity; smartphone workflow proven; expected net amount and payment date stated; effective value beats one existing day shift or reliably closes the JPY 20,800 gap; no sensitive-data or off-platform requirement.
withdrawal_rule: Reject immediately when the advertised range is not the binding current contract, workload is undefined, or gap closure requires thousands of low-unit tasks.

effect_window.success: A binding application-worthy candidate passes every hard gate.
effect_window.withdrawal: Three consecutive scans produce no passing candidate, then change platform, customer, or employment layer instead of adjusting keywords.

usage.refresh_result: No newer committed state was available; last-confirmed values are preserved and not called fresh.

privacy: No person name, applicant identity, email, account identifier, message identifier, secret, or private profile content is stored.
